verdict.rationale: NVIDIA documents 'Project G-Assist,' a built-in AI assistant on GeForce RTX PCs that can tune, control, and optimize system settings — directly matching the delegate-tasks story. However, it's labeled a 'Project' (experimental/beta), with no independent hands-on corroboration of its task-delegation capabilities or scope beyond system tuning. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of G-Assist's task range and reliability, clarity on general-availability status beyond beta.
